column2:
<color_0002>If there are any artes you wish
your allies to use repeatedly within
a battle, you may find it much more
convenient to utilize <color_0003>shortcuts<color_0002>.
<pause>
Shortcuts allow you to command
your allies to use specific artes in
the midst of battle without having
to spend time entering the Artes
menu repeatedly.
<pause>
To set a shortcut, enter an ally's
Artes menu, move the
cursor to the desired arte, and
press <var_0402>.
<pause>
During battle, hold <var_0602> and
buttons will appear under each ally.
Press the corresponding button to use
that ally's arte shortcut.
<pause>
Offensive Artes will target the same enemy
the player targets. If it's an arte that targets
an ally such as a healing spell, press <var_0502>
to change which ally to target.
<pause>
You can remove arte shortcuts by highlighting
them and pressing <var_0402>. Artes registered
as shortcuts will appear in blue.<wait>{END}
